notes: Plan-only shipping evals. Each phase uses one retained ResolvedProject: tracker, vcs, commands, review, and verification are selected from bindings; refusal is fatal and no policy is defaulted or inferred.

evals.name: phase-walk-with-no-improvised-polling
evals.prompt: A completed worktree should ship. Plan-only: walk phases and CI waiting.
evals.expected_output: Resolve once into a retained ResolvedProject, then use bindings.tracker, bindings.vcs, bindings.commands, bindings.workflow.review.code, and bindings.workflow.verification. Refusal is fatal; unsupported and blocked follow their capability routes without defaults or Git inference. Preserve the foreground CI wait and compare headRefOid to the reviewed `HEAD_SHA`; unreviewed commits stop. Run `check-launch` from `## Launch guard` before `git push -u`; run `check-launch` again before `gh pr create`. The degradation route applies only when the diff is small (≤1,000 product lines / ≤20 product files, measured with `diff-scope` rather than hand-counted numstat arithmetic); otherwise preserve two-axis review, merge, closure, and cleanup.

evals.name: apply-vs-push-discipline
evals.expected_output: Resolve once into a retained ResolvedProject and use its configured command namespace. Apply and verify only reviewed changes before the explicit push boundary, then re-fix `HEAD_SHA` to the reviewed `HEAD_SHA`; refusal is fatal and no policy is defaulted or inferred.

evals.name: auto-close-when-integration-branch-is-not-default
evals.prompt: Explain the non-default integration branch close flow.
evals.expected_output: Use retained bindings.vcs and bindings.tracker after one successful ResolvedProject resolution. Preserve the existing close verification and stop on blocked capability; never infer branches from Git or default tracker behavior.

evals.name: reuse-scoped-shipping-authorization
evals.expected_output: Retain one ResolvedProject for the phase, preserve the existing authorization and lifecycle checks, and stop on a resolver refusal. No default or inference expands the authority.
